title: IMP 1970 starting party localization inventory and audit
audit_scope: All tags in generated IMP_1970_historical_ruling_party trigger and its scripted localization; English starting-party override values; original-tag country identities; selected historical corrections.
scenario_start_date: 1970-01-01 (as confirmed by project owner; scenario covers 1970–2000)

source_files.generator: tools/build_1970_party_localisation.py (referenced by generated output headers; absent from this checkout)

coverage.note: All 163 tags owning one or more states at the 1970-01-01 bookmark have scripted ruling-party localization coverage. Five reuse existing named keys. The companion IMP_1970_country_and_party_names file contains 29 additional named ideology-party keys for political-country variants, some of which can serve as opposition-party names. There is no uniform per-tag opposition registry; other party slots rely on shared/generated ideology names.
